# arXiv

> > Open-access preprint repository for scholarly articles across physics, mathematics, computer science, and other scientific disciplines

arXiv is a free distribution service and open-access archive for nearly 2.4 million scholarly articles in the fields of physics, mathematics, computer science, quantitative biology, quantitative finance, statistics, electrical engineering and systems science, and economics. Papers are submitted by researchers worldwide and are available immediately upon acceptance without traditional peer review, making it a vital resource for rapid scientific communication.
